title: Japanese-Style Grilled Bread
description: A simple Japanese-inspired recipe that uses grilled flatbread as the base for a delicious and savory snack.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Slice the flatbread into thin strips.
Grill the flatbread slices for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until crispy and slightly charred.
In a small bowl, mix together the juicy, polish, and rye.
Brush the flatbread slices with the mixture and season with salt and pepper.
Serve the grilled flatbread slices on top of two slices of bread.
Garnish with additional juicy, if desired.
